description: Fetch a Pinterest Board and its Pins. A Board is a user-curated collection (like a bookmark folder or album) that groups saved Pins by theme — this command returns the board's metadata (name, description, total Pin count, owner) plus the Pins inside it, scrolling to load more up to the limit. Requires a logged-in browser session.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Board URL in the form https://www.pinterest.com/<username>/<board-slug>/. Obtain it from get-user --tab saved output or search --type board results.（图板链接，形如 /<用户名>/<图板名>/；可从 get-user --tab saved 或 search --type board 的输出拿到。）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of Pins to return from the board (1-100, default 20). Boards can contain thousands of Pins; the command scrolls until the limit is reached or the board is exhausted (then returns fewer with partial=true).（返回图板内 Pin 数上限；图板可能有几千张 Pin，内部滚动加载，耗尽时标 partial=true。）
